prima_materia_raw: A malignant growth is described in sacred language.
vectors_raw: The Exegate interprets the growth as an inversion of grace. Through the Order lens, three drops could be administered during a hidden rite.
psych_pathology_raw: Sufferers may come to praise their own deterioration.
atmospherics_raw: Pitch-dark chamber, mineral damp, whispered praise.

scene_hooks.hook_text_raw: An initiate might receive three drops while surrendering a former name.

seed_lines.seed_line: Three drops, and the inward growth answers.
